encode_masks_rle: encode binary masks stored as numpy arrays into RLE format dictionaries
decode_rle_masks: decode RLE-encoded mask dictionaries back into binary numpy arrays
compute_iou_masks: compute intersection over union between detected and ground truth masks
merge_masks_union: compute union or intersection of multiple encoded RLE masks
get_mask_bounding_boxes: get bounding boxes surrounding encoded RLE masks as [x y w h] arrays
compute_mask_area: compute area of encoded RLE masks directly without decoding
convert_polyobjects_to_rle: convert polygons, bounding boxes, and uncompressed RLE to encoded RLE masks
